subject: Re: Pegasus.ai + Redwood — Co-hosted field workshop and demo day
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@pegasus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@pegasus.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pegasus + Redwood: Field workshop pilot (Dec/Jan)

Hi Marissa —

Quick intro: I run partnerships at Pegasus.ai (we build a vector search + retrieval layer used by a lot of LLM apps). We loved the Redwood runtime talk at LLM Summit and think there’s a great fit for a co-hosted field workshop aimed at developer teams and solution architects — short talks + hands-on mini-labs + customer stories.

High-level idea: 90-minute regional workshop, in-person + hybrid stream, joint promotion to our lists. Goal is net-new lead generation and a product integration narrative (Pegasus retrieval + Redwood inference). We can pilot in SF in late Dec or early Jan. Pegasus can cover venue and light catering; would Redwood be open to a co-branded session and demo pods?

Attached is a draft agenda (pegasus_agenda_v2.pdf) — very rough. Would love to sync 30 min next week to align on scope and audience, and to confirm dates.

Thanks —
Asha Menon
Head of Partnerships, Pegasus.ai
asha@pegasus.ai
+1 (415) 555-0119

Hi Asha —

Thanks — super interested. Congrats on the great agenda. A few quick thoughts from our side:

- Redwood can bring a live inference demo pod (short 10–12 min walk-throughs) showing latency/cost comparisons across model variants. We’ll also prepare a short \"how we integrated Pegasus retrieval\" tech slide.
- Audience: target developer leads + ML engineers from scale-ups (50–500 eng). That matches the folks who attend our SF meetups.
- Dates: Dec 20–22 are tight for many; early Jan (12–20) is cleaner. Do you have venue availability in that window?

I’m looping Karthik (tech partner lead) to confirm the tech format and Ben for field/events ops and promo.

I’m available for a 30-min sync on Wed 12/2 at 10am PT or Thu 12/3 at 2pm PT — I dropped a booking link below. If those don’t work, share times and we’ll adapt.

Cal: https://cal.com/marissa/pegasus-workshop-30

Best,

Asha and I propose this split: 20 min joint keynote (strategic value of retrieval + inference), two 12-min customer case studies, two 20-min technical minisessions (one from each vendor), 30-min hands-on labs in pods. We’ll run a 30-min networking/demo hour after the formal program.

Attachments: pegasus_agenda_v2.pdf (updated), sample-attendee-list.csv (redacted).

If Jan 14 works for Redwood, can Marissa, Karthik, and Ben confirm by EOD Monday 12/7 so we can lock the venue and start a joint registration page? Also including a quick ask: can Redwood provide a 6-slide demo deck + 1 single-slide "how we integrated Pegasus" tech diagram by 12/10?
